# AppCreateRequest

Creates an app with no versions yet.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes | The app's name, unique within its namespace. At most 150 characters. Constraints: maxLength: 150, required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |

## Example

```json
{
  "name": "..."
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`apps.create`](../api/apps.md) (`POST /namespaces/{namespaceName}/apps`)
